name: Aquaporin A/S
summary: Aquaporin A/S is a specialized water technology company focused on engineering and distributing innovative products for purifying potable water, including drinking water membranes, hollow fiber forward osmosis modules, and complete water purification systems used in drinking water provision, industrial processes, medical applications like hemodialysis, and the food and beverage industry. Founded in 2005, Aquaporin A/S is headquartered in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark.
